what_is_working: One partner-state strip, and it is the same component everywhere: the top 230 rows of 01_pulse.png, 02_chat.png, 03_us.png, 04_moments.png, 05_settings.png, 12_search.png and 13_messenger_states.png differ from each other by a mean of 0.001 of 255 - pixel-identical - so partner state is legible on all five regions and not only on Pulse.

That strip is live, not painted on: in 08_state_propagating.mp4 it reads TRAVELLING at frames 1, 150, 240 and 394 and OUT at 396, 410 and 502, flipping at exactly the frame 08_state_propagating.json names for 'state place out' (at_frame 395), and it does so while the app is showing Us, not Pulse.

One log, one cursor, one standing line: 01/02/03/04/05/12 report the same events count (14062), sync.cursor equal to peer_cursor, and byte-identical ambient.standing_line 'bright / week one, and the room smells right again / travelling / 7 hours ago' in all seven reports.

Module events are ordinary rows in Chat rather than a second stream: 02_chat.report.json gives the visible kinds as message 4, state_passive 1, voice_note 1, ritual_kept 1, video 1, and 02_chat.png draws the rituals event as 'text when home ... KEPT' on graph paper at y 1469-1667 and the state event as the quiet rule 'you went out - Tue 4 Aug 06:28' at y 1090, both carrying the same timestamp typography as the messages above and below them.

The one log is one index: reliability.json's search capability returns hits across nine event types (message, photo, todo_event, date_event, feeling, state_declared, milestone, video, voice_note), and coldstart.json shows a message and a feeling in each direction landing in the same order on both nodes (spine_host_order == spine_client_order, same_order_both_sides true, four_events_at 0-3 on both sides). reliability.json also keeps ephemerals out of it - typing 'neither log grew by it' - and folds reactions onto their target 'not a row'.

The Us modules report a uniform contract - {id, events, glance} for all five - and the two that are drawn use one section grammar: glance card, then a small-caps section label at the left with 'add one' at the right, then the entries (03_us.png, AHEAD/BEEN under dates and OPEN under todos).

One feeling vocabulary, and an authored feeling is not a special case: haptics.check.json counts 36 feelings, 34 built-in and 2 authored, across six families that match the picker's categories in 15_authored_feeling.mp4 (WARMTH/ACHE/SHELTER/MISCHIEF/STATIC/SPARKLE), and haptics_strip.png shows the two authored ones ('pigeon' mischief 750ms, 'tuesday soup' shelter 1200ms) on the same 3500ms scale and inside the same families as the built-in 34, with near_shapes empty.

A feeling is the same object wherever it appears: in 15_authored_feeling.mp4 the same modelled object is picked from the grid (frames 19-76), sent, drawn as a chat row 'pigeon / Thu 3 Sep 19:40 / going' (frame 151), and then lands over Settings (frames 289-363); in 07_feeling_landing.mp4 the same objects land over Pulse, over Chat and over the Us dates module without changing form.

verdict: The strongest clause of this row is the one that is best shown. The partner strip is not merely similar across the five regions, it is pixel-identical - a mean difference of 0.001 of 255 across seven artifacts - and 08_state_propagating.mp4 proves it is live by flipping it from TRAVELLING to OUT at frame 395, the exact frame the scene log names, while the app is sitting in Us. Every region report reads the same event count and the same standing line off one cursor; a rituals event and a state event sit in the Chat thread as ordinary rows with the same timestamp typography as the messages beside them; reliability.json searches nine event types out of one index and coldstart.json puts a message and a feeling on the same spine in the same order on both nodes; the 36 feelings share six families and one haptic scale, and the two authored ones are indistinguishable in kind from the 34 built-in. That is a system, not an assembly. What it is missing is the showing of its own edges. The single artifact re-captured this cycle is the one that broke: the video row in 02_chat.png is now an empty 62px strip although the report still counts it and reliability says its blobs arrive, so a region that is meant to be a view onto the log has stopped drawing one of the log's types. Three of the five shared-life modules and two of the three Moments lenses - 1340 feelings and 142 milestones among them - are never drawn in any artifact or clip, so the claim that a fifth module would fit the pattern of the first four rests on a report field rather than on anything a reader can look at. And the second platform is absent outright: two missing artifacts, both of them the Android and two-device ones, a whole capture stamped webkit, and 'no Android device was up in this session' offered as the reason. Around that sit smaller seams - the internal identifier 'state_declared' surfacing in a reply banner, filter lenses drawn as twelve full-width strips in Search and as four small chips in Moments, an active lens marked only by seven pixels of cap height beside chips that use a yellow card. The architecture reads as one thing; the evidence shows about three fifths of it, and the fifth it did re-shoot came back worse.
